what: América Móvil is the largest mobile operator in Latin America. Founded by Carlos Slim, it serves hundreds of millions of customers in Mexico, Brazil, Colombia and across the region under the Telcel and Claro brands, and also sells fixed broadband and pay television.
customers: Households and businesses across Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Central America and parts of Europe.
money: Telcel mobile and Telmex fixed services
Claro mobile, broadband and pay television
moat: Spectrum and network scale in markets where it often has the largest share, built over three decades and difficult to attack.
risks: Mexican regulators have historically imposed rules on it as the dominant operator
Currency moves across many Latin American markets affect reported results
Net margin of about 9% is modest for a telecom operator
Debt of about $37 billion against little cash
opportunities: Fibre broadband is being rolled out across Mexico and Brazil
Prepaid customers are steadily converting to higher-value postpaid plans
watch: Mexican mobile service revenue and postpaid subscriber growth.
